description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity named GLES20Activity that demonstrates how to check for OpenGL ES 2.0 support at runtime and initialize a GLSurfaceView accordingly.

classes.name: GLES20Activity
classes.description: An Android Activity that detects OpenGL ES 2.0 support at runtime and initializes the GLSurfaceView with appropriate renderer.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the GLSurfaceView and sets the renderer based on device support for OpenGL ES 2.0.

methods.name: detectOpenGLES20
methods.description: Checks if the device supports OpenGL ES 2.0 by querying the system configuration.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Delegates the resume action to the GLSurfaceView.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Delegates the pause action to the GLSurfaceView.
